constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero

banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)

constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

sentences.en: Kafka is not a database with a different name.

sentences.ar: ده log: الـproducers بيضيفوا events في الآخر، والـconsumers بيقروا لقدام، والأحداث بتفضل موجودة مدة retention سواء حد قراها أو لأ.
sentences.en: It is a log: producers append events to the end, consumers read forward, and events stay for a retention window whether anyone has read them or not.

sentences.ar: والـtopic مقسّم partitions، وأهي الحقيقة اللي بتحدد تصميمك: الترتيب مضمون جوه الـpartition، مش على مستوى الـtopic.
sentences.en: A topic is split into partitions, and here is the fact that decides your design: ordering is guaranteed within a partition, not across the topic.

sentences.ar: لو حدثين لازم يتعالجوا بالترتيب، لازم يشاركوا نفس الـkey عشان ينزلوا في نفس الـpartition.
sentences.en: If two events must be processed in order, they must share a key so they land in the same partition.

sentences.ar: وكل consumer ماسك offset المكان اللي وصله وتقدر تشوف العلامة دي وهي بتتحرك بدل ما تصدّق الكلام.
sentences.en: Each consumer keeps an offset — the position it has reached — and you can watch that marker move rather than take the word on trust.

sentences.ar: والـconsumer group بيوزّع الـpartitions؛ ضيف consumer والمجموعة تعمل rebalance، وأثناء الـrebalance الـlatency بتهتز، وده يستاهل تعرفه قبل ما يحصل في production.
sentences.en: A consumer group shares the partitions out; add a consumer and the group rebalances, and during that rebalance latency wobbles, which is worth knowing before it happens in production.

sentences.ar: والـlag هو المسافة بين آخر offset متاح وآخر واحد اتعالج،
sentences.en: Lag is the distance between the last available offset and the last processed one,

sentences.ar: والـlag أنفع رقم في نظام streaming بس بشرط تشوف سببه في نفس اللقطة، وهو هنا sink بطيء في الآخر.
sentences.en: and lag is the single most useful number in a streaming system — but only when you can see its cause in the same frame, which here is a slow sink downstream.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي التسليم. الـconsumer عالج الرسالة وبعدها وقع قبل ما يـcommit الـoffset.
sentences.en: Now delivery. The consumer processed the message and then crashed before committing the offset.

sentences.ar: ولما رجع عالج نفس الرسالة تاني.
sentences.en: On restart it processes the same message again.

sentences.ar: والـexactly-once خاصية للمسار كله، مش إعداد في Kafka والجواب العملي هو at-least-once على sink بتكون idempotent، ونفس الكلمة دي هي اللي نجّتنا في شابتر الـDAG.
sentences.en: Exactly-once is a property of the whole path, not a Kafka setting — the practical answer is at-least-once delivery into a sink that is idempotent, which is the same word that saved us in the DAG chapter.

sentences.ar: ولما الـschema يتغيّر: إضافة field بقيمة افتراضية متوافقة؛ وحذف field الـconsumers محتاجاه لأ، والـregistry المفروض يرفضه قبل ما يوصل لحد.
sentences.en: And when the schema changes: adding a field with a default is compatible; removing a field consumers require is not, and the registry should refuse it before it reaches anyone.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: A named, append-only stream of events in Kafka, split into partitions; ordering is guaranteed within a partition, not across the topic.
concepts.def_ar: الـtopic قناة أحداث باسم في Kafka، بتتقسم لـpartitions؛ الترتيب مضمون جوه الـpartition الواحد بس، مش على الـtopic كله.
concepts.failure: Assuming global ordering across a topic; only each partition preserves order.

concepts.failure: Choosing a partition key queries never filter on, so nothing is pruned.

concepts.def_en: A set of consumers that share a topic's partitions, each partition read by exactly one member, to scale reading in parallel.
concepts.def_ar: الـconsumer group مجموعة consumers بتتقاسم الـpartitions بتاعة الـtopic، وكل partition بيقراه عضو واحد بس، عشان القراءة تتوزع.
concepts.failure: Adding more consumers than partitions; the extra consumers sit idle.

concepts.def_en: The reassignment of partitions among a consumer group's members when a consumer joins, leaves or fails; latency wobbles meanwhile.
concepts.def_ar: الـrebalance هو إعادة توزيع الـpartitions على أعضاء الـconsumer group لما consumer ينضم أو يخرج أو يقع، وأثناءها الـlatency بتهتز.
concepts.failure: Scaling consumers up during peak load, triggering a rebalance that worsens latency.

concepts.failure: Judging speed by one run's milliseconds; load makes wall-clock time vary between runs.
